LanguageData.BOR_Gun_Autopistol_TI.label: solar pistol
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_Autopistol_TI.description:
A simple blowback-operated self-loading pistol. Quick to fire with reasonable accuracy, but at the cost of damage and armor penetration.
This weapon is commonly used by petty criminals within Solar Republics, but can otherwise be found throughout the stars wielded by Crime-Lords or high-end Enforcers.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_LMG_TI.label: solar lmg
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_LMG_TI.description: A light machine gun produced by the Solar Republics for sustained suppressive fire. Durable, hard-hitting, and exceptionally reliable under prolonged combat stress, this platform outperforms most ultratech-standard squad automatics.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_ChainShotgun_TI.label: solar chain shotgun
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_ChainShotgun_TI.description: A drum-fed fully automatic shotgun, less precise with a shorter effective range than standard models. Oftentimes battles fought between the squabbling Solar Republics have so many warriors doing battle that accuracy is far less important than capacity and rate of fire.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_AssaultRifle_TI.label: solar assault rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_AssaultRifle_TI.description: A general-purpose rifle often issued to Rank-and-File soldiers within Solar Republics, the weapon is moderately effective at all ranges and comes with a built-in holographic 'flip-up' sight. The design has been attributed to a number of Republics, though none of which can verify their claims to its manufacture.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SniperRifle_TI.label: solar sniper rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SniperRifle_TI.description: A bolt-action 'rifle' which launches shards of Sunsteel at whatever sorry fool the weapon is pointed toward. While having exceptional range, accuracy, and power, the multi-zoom thermal scope cannot be removed and conventional ironsights are not present, causing other weapons to outclass it at close range.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_DMR_TI.label: dmr solar bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_DMR_TI.label: solar dmr
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_DMR_TI.description: A semi-automatic marksman rifle issued to squad sharpshooters within Solar Republic line units. Built on a lengthened assault rifle receiver with a heavier barrel and a fixed holographic magnifier, it bridges the gap between the assault rifle and the sniper rifle, trading volume of fire for reach and precision.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_Bullpup_TI.label: bullpup solar bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_Bullpup_TI.label: solar bullpup
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_Bullpup_TI.description: A compact bullpup carbine favoured by Solar Republic boarding crews, vehicle crews and urban security units. Moving the action behind the grip keeps the weapon short enough to swing through hatchways and corridors, while a high cyclic rate makes up for its shorter barrel at close range.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_GaussPistol_TI.label: solar gauss pistol bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussPistol_TI.label: solar gauss pistol
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussPistol_TI.description: Refined Solarite integration enables electromagnetic acceleration of Sunsteel rounds to devastating effect. The Solar Republics' counter-mechanoid specialists relied on this compact pistol to supplement their arsenal, its superior kickback management allowing sustained fire despite the weapon's formidable power output.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_GaussBattleRifle_TI.label: solar gauss rifle bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussBattleRifle_TI.label: solar gauss rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussBattleRifle_TI.description: A versatile electromagnetic rifle utilizing Solar Republics' breakthrough in Solarite-enhanced weapon design. Built specifically for counter-mechanoid operations, the rifle's refined recoil distribution allows even moderately-trained soldiers to maintain accurate sustained fire when facing hostile synthetic threats.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_GaussShotgun_TI.label: solar gauss shotgun blast
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussShotgun_TI.label: solar gauss shotgun
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussShotgun_TI.description: A compact electromagnetic shotgun engineered by the Solar Republics for intense close-quarters counter-mechanoid engagements. Solarite reinforcement allows the weapon's frame to withstand the immense recoil forces from its unique fragmented projectile design, making it devastating in the hands of well-trained specialists.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_GaussDMR_TI.label: solar gauss dmr bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussDMR_TI.label: solar gauss dmr
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussDMR_TI.description: A designated marksman rifle developed by the Solar Republics for counter-mechanoid specialists. Solarite integration provides exceptional accuracy and stopping power against synthetic targets, while the weapon's recoil compensation system allows sustained rapid fire without degrading accuracy.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_GaussBullpup_TI.label: solar gauss bullpup bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussBullpup_TI.label: solar gauss bullpup
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussBullpup_TI.description: A compact yet powerful electromagnetic rifle built for close-quarters counter-mechanoid operations. The Solarite-enhanced frame absorbs the intense recoil forces generated by the gauss accelerator, enabling effective suppressive fire in confined spaces where Solar Republic anti-synthetics teams operate.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_GaussSniperRifle_TI.label: solar gauss sniper rifle bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussSniperRifle_TI.label: solar gauss sniper rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussSniperRifle_TI.description: The pinnacle of Solar Republic counter-mechanoid firepower. This precision electromagnetic rifle features Solarite reinforcement throughout its frame to withstand the immense stresses of electromagnetic acceleration. Deployed by elite anti-synthetic specialists, it delivers devastating firepower at extreme range with minimal recoil.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_GaussCannon_TI.label: solar gauss cannon shot
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussCannon_TI.label: solar gauss cannon
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussCannon_TI.description: A rapid-fire electromagnetic cannon developed by the Solar Republics as the ultimate counter-mechanoid suppressive weapon. Solarite reinforcement allows sustained burst fire without structural degradation, and the weapon's recoil management system enables accurate fire despite its devastating power.
